title: baocd
text: baocd is a BasedPL port of advent-of-code-data for AoC puzzle data in SolveIt.

title: baocd
text:
Setup

Log in to Advent of Code
Open browser Dev Tools and copy the session cookie.
Set it as AOC_SESSION in your SolveIt secrets.

title: baocd
text:
Usage

Get Data
from baocd import get_puzzle

p = get_puzzle(day=1, year=2026)
lines = p.input_data
ex = p.example


Submit
p.submit(answer)
input_data is a BPL Array of split lines. For the raw text format use .raw_input_data.

Puzzle


source

Puzzle
def Puzzle(
    year, day, token:NoneType=None
):
Thin lazy-property facade for an Advent of Code puzzle (input_data, examples, title, submit).



Tests

_orig = (AOCD_DATA_DIR, AOCD_CONFIG_DIR, _token2id, http_get, http_post)
tmp_root = mkdir(host("temp"), unique=1, prefix="baocd_puz_")
try:
    AOCD_DATA_DIR = AOCD_CONFIG_DIR = tmp_root
    _token2id = None
    _prose = '<article><h2>--- Day 1: Secret Entrance ---</h2><pre><code>L68\nR48\n</code></pre><p>Ans <code>3</code></p></article>'
    _routes = {
        "https://adventofcode.com/settings": (200, '<code>ownerproof-42-1-a</code><span>Link to https://github.com/bpl</span>'),
        "https://adventofcode.com/2025/day/1/input": (200, "L68\nR48\n"),
        "https://adventofcode.com/2025/day/1": (200, _prose),
    }
    http_get = lambda url, token=None: Array(status=_routes[pystr(url)][0], body=Array(_routes[pystr(url)][1]))
    http_post = lambda url, token, fields: Array(status=200, body=Array("<article><p>That's the right answer!</p></article>"))

    p = Puzzle(2025, 1, token="live_tok_9999")
    test(p.input_data, Array(["L68", "R48"]), beq)
    test(p.title, Array("Secret Entrance"), beq)
    test(p.examples[0].input_data, Array(["L68", "R48"]), beq)
    test(p.example, Array(["L68", "R48"]), beq)
    p.submit(Array(10), reopen=False, quiet=True)
    test(p.answer_a, Array("10"), beq)
finally:
    AOCD_DATA_DIR, AOCD_CONFIG_DIR, _token2id, http_get, http_post = _orig
    remove(tmp_root, recurse=1)

Tacit String, Line, & Record Combinators
Pure tacit BasedPL Function variables built with atop, fork, |, .before, .each, and .agenda.
Small Python-to-BPL interop helpers and keyed record update.

bstr
def bstr(
    x
):
Ensure x is a BasedPL character vector Array.




source

pystr
def pystr(
    x
):
Extract a Python str from a BasedPL Array or Python value.




source

beq
def beq(
    a, b
):
Structural equality via BasedPL match (≡), safely handling None.




source

rec_set
def rec_set(
    rec, key, val
):
Return keyed BasedPL Array rec with key set to val.



test(bstrip("  hello \n "), Array("hello"), beq)
test(bsplit_lines("L68\nL30\n\nR48\n"), Array(["L68", "L30", "", "R48"]), beq)
test(bjoin(", ", Array(["aa", "bb", "cc"])), Array("aa, bb, cc"), beq)

Pure Tacit HTML Extraction & Entity Decoding
Replaces a full DOM parser with tacit BasedPL •r, •replace, 16⊥, and •ucs.


source

unescape_html
def unescape_html(
    text
):
Decode numeric and named HTML entities natively on BasedPL Arrays.




source

tag_texts
def tag_texts(
    html, tag, strip_ws:bool=False
):
Extract inner text of every <tag>...</tag> element as a list of unescaped BasedPL Arrays.



test(unescape_html("a < b & A B"), Array("a < b & A B"), beq)
test(tag_texts("<article><pre><code>L68\n<x></code></pre></article>", "pre")[0], Array("L68\n<x>"), beq)

    val
):
Convert an answer (BPL Array, int, integral float/complex, bytes, str) to a BasedPL string Array.
